name: Push-Up
description: The full push-up: from a straight-arm plank on your toes, lower your chest until your elbows are bent to 90°, then press back up.

source.title: Push-Up (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Start in a plank: hands under your shoulders, legs straight, on your toes.
cues: Brace your stomach so your body stays in one line.
Lower with control; press the floor away to come up.
Too hard? Try knee or wall push-ups.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Plank
keyframes.cue: Arms straight, body in one line.

keyframes.name: Lower
keyframes.cue: Bend your elbows until your upper arms are level.
